title: What is emotional support (Wellness)?
body:
What is emotional support (Wellness)?

Mood & Support is self-help: check-ins, exercises, and chat with a digital friend (AI).

⚠️ This is NOT medical care, NOT therapy, and NOT live chat with a doctor or counselor.

If crisis signs appear, the app suggests a trusted adult or public helplines (112 / 8-800-2000-122 in Russia).

✅ ALADDIN helps notice mood and take a small step — without diagnoses or prescriptions.
